Absence of Colors is a french post-metal band formed in 2022.

Drawing inspiration from doom, stoner, post-rock and broader alternative influences, the band shapes a rich and contrasting sonic landscape.  Their music is both hypnotic and powerful, delving into dark, abrasive textures while cultivating a deeply atmospheric sensibility.

Primarily instrumental, Absence of Colors’ music has developed its own language by embracing unconventional structures and electronic experimentation.
